import json, os, shutil, tarfile
from pathlib import Path
from monai_workflow.runtime import run
incoming = Path(os.environ['MONAI_PROVIDER_INPUT'])
outgoing = Path(os.environ['MONAI_PROVIDER_OUTPUT'])
with tarfile.open(incoming / 'input.tar') as archive:
    members = archive.getmembers()
    if len(members) != 1 or not members[0].isfile():
        raise ValueError('Input archive must contain exactly one regular NIfTI volume')
    member = members[0]
    if member.name in ('', '.', '..') or Path(member.name).name != member.name:
        raise ValueError('Archive the volume at its basename, without directory entries or links')
    if not member.name.lower().endswith(('.nii', '.nii.gz')):
        raise ValueError('Use a .nii or .nii.gz CT volume')
    extracted = incoming / 'extracted'
    extracted.mkdir()
    volume = extracted / member.name
    with archive.extractfile(member) as source, volume.open('xb') as target:
        shutil.copyfileobj(source, target)
parameters = json.loads(os.environ.get('MONAI_PARAMETERS_JSON', '{}'))
run(volume, outgoing, parameters, device='cuda')
